text: Abigail gripped the sleek, carbon-fiber railing of the orbital shuttle as it hummed its way across the void towards the new world. It was 2147, and she was leaving behind the stifling constraints of her traditional life in a small, subterranean colony on Earth for the promise of independence and adventure in the Martian colonies. She clutched her small, battered data-slate that contained all her worldly possessions, her heart racing with both fear and excitement. Tell me what a book is primarily made of.
